subject.title: feat: add lease-bound metadata to session spawns

question: Should OpenClaw core own this Agentic OS-specific lease, metadata, persistence, and RPC contract, or should core expose only a generic extension seam for the downstream integration?
rationale: The branch adds a new externally discoverable control-plane API and durable session-state contract whose ownership and compatibility promise cannot be selected mechanically.

options.title: Extract owner contract
options.body: Move the Agentic OS method names, metadata schema, replay policy, and projections to the owner integration, with a separately reviewed generic core seam if one is genuinely missing.

options.title: Sponsor a core contract
options.body: Explicitly accept the new core Gateway API and durable state model, then require public API, upgrade, and current-head real-runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Close or defer the branch until a maintainer sponsors the external-orchestrator contract and its permanent ownership boundary.

recommendation.title: Extract owner contract
recommendation.body: Move the Agentic OS method names, metadata schema, replay policy, and projections to the owner integration, with a separately reviewed generic core seam if one is genuinely missing.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository-member involvement in related session-spawn routing makes this the best available low-confidence routing candidate for the core ownership decision.
